zh-CN.title: 奖励预览与真实聊天对齐
items: 聊天背景与气泡奖励改用真实聊天页预览，仅展示一条己方消息
底部轨道复用个性化中的背景样片和气泡胶囊
修复竖屏滑动第四项时整个奖励页面被横向拖动的问题

en.title: Reward previews now match real chats
items: Chat background and bubble rewards now use the real chat preview with one outgoing message
The reward rail reuses the same background swatches and bubble capsules as personalization
Fixed the entire reward page sliding sideways when reaching the fourth item in portrait mode
